context: Six independent sub-moves, each landable alone; order by risk: (6) system profiler, (5) complexity table, (2) exporters, (3) dry-run, (4) validation, (1) analytics assembly. For each: characterize current MCP output shape, move logic to core, keep the MCP tool as schema-validation + core call + response envelope. Where CLI has a parallel implementation (exporters, dryrun), converge on one and delete the other in the same sub-move.
description: Relocate MCP-layer business logic that has no core counterpart, per the review. (1) analyze_results modes regressions/trends/aggregate (benchbox/mcp/tools/analytics.py:533-601, :678-731, :787-857) move to a core results-analysis module (statistics and policy already unified by prior items; this moves file discovery/grouping/assembly). (2) results.py exporters: _export_results_impl CSV/HTML/JSON (:216-296), _generate_html_report (:299-357), _export_summary_impl text/markdown (:360-408) reconcile with core/results/exporter.py and benchbox/cli/output.py ResultExporter -- one exporter family in core serves both surfaces (pick per-format winners; delete the losers). (3) _dry_run_impl estimation (benchmark.py:612-710: memory heuristic :694, hardcoded phases :684) merges into core/dryrun.py alongside the CLI's dryrun path. (4) _validate_config_impl (benchmark.py:713-817) second validation implementation merges into core schema validation. (5) _get_query_complexity_hints 90-line TPC-H table (benchmark.py:965-1059) moves into benchmark registry/metadata. (6) system_profile switches from raw psutil (discovery.py:113-139) to core/system.py SystemProfiler; the _recommend_max_scale_factor heuristic (:402-415) moves to core beside it. Truncation limits (query lists 30, files 20, inline content 50000) stay at the MCP layer as protocol-scoped presentation.

anti_patterns.dont: move tenant path containment or truncation into core
anti_patterns.instead: keep protocol/security concerns at the MCP layer; move only the domain logic
anti_patterns.why: those are interface-necessary per the scoped-surfaces contract

preserves.behavior: HTML export keeps html.escape XSS handling wherever the generator ends up.
MCP tool response schemas and docs tables stay in sync (schema-derived docs tests green).
MCP truncation limits keep their current values (protocol-scoped, ledger-documented).
Path-traversal and tenant-containment checks in results.py (:170-175, :254-270) remain at the MCP layer.
